name: O-Voxel
definition: A sparse, voxel-based native 3D representation designed for high-quality 3D generation and reconstruction. It utilizes a Flexible Dual Grid formulation to robustly represent surfaces with arbitrary topology (including non-manifold and open surfaces) and volumetric surface properties such as Physically-Based Rendering (PBR) material attributes.
summary: O-Voxel is a sparse, voxel-based 3D representation that uses a Flexible Dual Grid and enhanced Quadratic Error Function to accurately capture sharp features and open boundaries without requiring watertight meshes.
